heroIntro: From emergency-response systems to everyday commerce, I turn complicated problems into software people can rely on.
projectOneDescription: A centralized operations platform for Madhya Pradesh’s mobile ambulance service, bringing case logging, vehicle tracking, staff coordination, and reporting into one system.
projectOneImageAlt: Certificate recognizing Tanishk for designing software for a government mobile ambulance program
projectTwoDescription: A full-stack storefront and operations dashboard with secure sign-in, live inventory, and integrated payments, designed to keep the shopping experience simple as the catalog grows.
projectThreeDescription: An end-to-end meal ordering experience connecting customers with tiffin providers, with order tracking and automated email workflows keeping every handoff clear.
aboutLead: I’m Tanishk, a full-stack engineer who enjoys finding the simple shape inside a complex problem.
aboutParagraphOne: I care about what happens after launch: how a system behaves under pressure, how another developer makes sense of it, and whether the person using it can get on with their day.
aboutParagraphTwo: My work spans public-service systems, commerce, and the small operational details that hold products together. I bring a systems mindset, a hands-on approach, and a healthy respect for the edge cases.
contactDescription: Open to thoughtful teams, interesting products, and conversations about building things that last.
